_comment: Class Progression (design doc v3): each class here gets a hard FORK at 'fork_level' into two lanes; classes absent from this file simply level along their base tables. Each lane: 'name' + 'archetype' (the name shown from capstone level on), 'blurb' (shown on the choice card), 'offsets' (permanent adds to the class table: hit = to-hit AND damage, ac = armor class, sp = spell points, detect = trap/secret %), 'passive' (always-on, from the passive list below), 'verb' (the signature action gained at its 'level'), 'capstone' (gained at its 'level'; numbers tunable), 'refinement' (upgrades the verb at its 'level'), and 'rite' (the Level 20 Rite, see below). PASSIVES: weapon_focus (+dmg with a chosen weapon category — the player picks which at the fork), braced_stance (-'reduce' damage taken per hit while a shield is worn), vital_strike, keen_senses, prepared_mind (the Wizard lane's spellbook: only prepared spells are castable; slots = 'slots_base' + max spell level; re-pick freely at each rest), overchannel (the Sorcerer lane: every cast costs 'discount' less SP, floor 1; knows only 'known_per_level' spells per spell level, picked on unlock), blessed_hands (+'heal' HP on every heal spell), sacred_weapon (+'dmg' divine damage on weapon hits). VERBS: rampage, guardians_stand, assassinate, vanish, arcane_insight (once per battle, your action: choose +'hit' to-hit, +'dc' save DC, or +'dmg' spell damage for the rest of the fight), overcast (toggle: pay 'cost_mult'x SP to cast a spell one level higher — +'extra_dice' damage/healing, +'dc_bonus' DC), mercy (free reaction: an ally cut to 0 HP immediately rises with 'dice' + WIS HP), zealous_strike (toggle: each landed melee hit spends 'cost' SP for +'dice' divine damage and 'heal' self-healing). CAPSTONES: rage, bulwark, lethality, set_trap, archmage (once per rest: cast ANY spellbook spell, prepared or not, for ALL remaining SP), twin_surge (once per rest: a spell resolves twice, then you are Exhausted a round), miracle (once per rest, ALL remaining SP, 'min_sp' minimum: the living are fully healed, the fallen rise at half), divine_inspiration (ALL remaining SP, 'min_sp' minimum: +'hit'/+'dmg'/+'ac' for 'rounds' rounds). REFINEMENTS: rampage_crits, stand_half_cost, assassinate_low_hp, vanish_free, insight_double (Arcane Insight grants TWO bonus types), overcast_cheap (Overcast costs 1.5x, rounded up), mercy_cures (Mercy also cures one condition), zealous_immunity (a Zealous Strike grants immunity to conditions until your next turn). TESTING TIP: the Playtest Bench (P) banks XP and bumps playstyle counters — the fastest road to any milestone.
_rite_comment: THE LEVEL 20 RITE (doc v3). 'sigil' lists the shared 8x8x8 vocabulary — every hero draws from the same pool. Per lane, 'rite' has: 'ability' (the unique capstone verb — engine knows 'whirlwind' and 'aegis'; name/numbers are CONTENT FLAGS, rename and retune freely), 'tracked' (which playstyle counter gates the title: rampageKills or standSaves), and 'tiers' — three entries, low to high: 'min' (counter needed; thresholds are proposals, doc says TBD pending playtesting) and 'title' (offered wording; the player may re-word it but keeps the tier). Tier 2 grants 'trinket' (an item id); tier 3 also records the lane's vignette-dungeon unlock (the dungeon itself is a later build).

sigil_art._comment: The visual sigil layers (generated by tools/genart.py from data/art_manifest.json — regenerate any piece there). Each vocabulary word above maps to a white-on-transparent image the engine TINTS with the color hex and composites (shape under, modifier over). A word with no entry here (or a missing file) simply falls back to words-only — nothing breaks. Dark colors automatically get a pale glow so they read on dark panels.

thief._comment: Doc v3 Thief. STEALTH TERMS the engine provides: a foe is UNAWARE until it has taken its first turn in a battle THE PARTY STARTED (bumping them — ambushes give no surprise), or when the attacker is HIDDEN (Vanish). A foe beside two or more heroes is FLANKED. Numbers here (vital_strike dmg, keen_senses bonus, lethality multiplier, trap dice, detect offsets) are all proposals — tune freely.
